patterns: APPSC asks crop -> leading state one-liners (largest tea producer = Assam), board headquarters matching (Tea Kolkata, Coffee Bengaluru, Rubber Kottayam, Tobacco Guntur, Spices Kochi).
APPSC Group-1 uses reasoning statement items (why tropical sugarcane out-yields north: cool nights, latitude, long sunshine) and rabi-only oilseed = mustard.
AP tilt: Guntur chillies/Agri Export Zone, Tobacco Board at Guntur, Araku Arabica GI, Paat-Mitro for jute farmers.
Other PSCs heavily repeat revolutions (Yellow = oilseeds, Pink = onion, Blue = fish), rubber = Kerala, coffee >70% Karnataka, world ranks (tea 2nd after China).
App MCQs lean on climate-requirement tables and multi-statement world-producer items; rank facts that change year to year (cotton, spices, coconut) are the main source of ambiguity.
